$comment: Template for the DA.live project config. Paste these values into DA Settings → Config for the hyvr-eds site (DA stores config on its side; this file is the source-controlled record). Replace <program>/<env>/<tenant> with your provisioned Adobe values. AEM Assets keys require an Assets tenant (gap G-BP1-2).

assets.$comment: Connects DA's asset selector to your AEM Assets (Dynamic Media) repository so authors pick from the DAM and links use the delivery renditions the blocks expect (?width=&format=webply).
